failure_patterns.pattern: rule_missing: Terse or elliptical prompts led to repeating a list, abstaining, or returning a role instead of identifying the intended relation.

rejected_edits.content: When a clue requests one singular role or entity but context offers alternative labels, choose the single label most directly defined by the clue; do not return an “or” list unless alternatives are requested. When a prompt consists only of a list of two or more names or entities, treat it as an implicit request for a shared attribute only if context clearly supports one (for example, a common jurisdiction or affiliation). Give that shared attribute rather than a generic summary of the entities' relationship; if no single shared attribute is clearly intended, do not guess.
